Support

# How can we help?

Most answers are in the docs. If yours is not, write to us: we answer by email ⟦q9: within a business day⟧.

## Common questions

A profile does not start Usually the proxy: a wrong address, or it wants a password. The profile does not open sites directly in that case.

Importing cookies Which files work, and what to do with the report of skipped entries.

Sync between Macs What syncs, how conflicts are resolved, how to revoke a Mac.

Forgot the master password It cannot be recovered. What you can do with the old vault.

## Write to us

Never send your master password, licence key or cookie export files. We will not ask for them.

Topic

Варианты: A question about using it · Billing and subscription · A bug in the app · Security

Email for our reply

Signing in with a key? Give any address for the reply — we delete it with the conversation.

Message

[поле: What you did, what you expected, and what happened]

Attach the app’s log

The logs hold none of your data in the clear — every build checks that.
